title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Alignment Check Charge Applied Toward an Alignment Correction Quote
content:
How the correction quote on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order treats the alignment check charge standing on the order depends on when the customer authorizes the correction:

- **within 3 days** of the order's latest out-of-spec check, the whole of that charge is applied toward the correction and the quote is the rated correction fee less that charge;
- **after 3 days but within the tier's alignment check validity days** of that check — 30 calendar days on every tier — half (0.5) of that charge, rounded to the cent, half up, is applied and the quote is the rated correction fee less that half;
- **later than that**, nothing is applied and the quote is the rated correction fee.

The correction quote is never below zero, and a correction quoted at zero posts no correction charge.

## Terms

- The **alignment check charge standing on the order** is the alignment check charge in the order's calibration money history less the write-offs booked against it.
- The **latest out-of-spec check** is the most recent alignment check recorded on the order whose result was out of spec.
- The **rated correction fee** is the correction fee the order is quoted at before any part of the check charge is applied.
- Days are calendar days counted from the date of the latest out-of-spec check to the day the customer authorizes the correction, the check date not counted. Where no out-of-spec check is recorded on the order, the days are taken as 99999 and nothing is applied.

## Day bands

| Days from the latest out-of-spec check to the authorization | Part of the standing check charge applied |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | the whole |
| 4 to 30 | half, rounded to the cent, half up |
| 31 or more | nothing |

Boundaries: authorizing 3 days after the check applies the whole; 4 days after applies half; 30 days after applies half; 31 days after applies nothing.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: rated correction fee 129.95 USD, check charge standing 59.95 USD)

| Days since the latest out-of-spec check | Applied | Correction quote |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | 59.95 | 70.00 |
| 10 | 29.98 (half of 59.95 is 29.975, rounded half up) | 99.97 |
| 40 | 0.00 | 129.95 |

**A quote that would fall below zero (hypothetical).** A rated correction fee of 50.00 USD with a standing check charge of 59.95 USD, authorized 1 day after the check: 50.00 less 59.95 would be below zero, so the correction quote is 0.00, and a correction quoted at zero posts no correction charge.
